relation_prior_finding.definition: Each relation and zero-valued reference have equal total prior mass at equal raw logits. Nonreference mass is R/(R+1), not independent of relation count.
relation_prior_finding.interpretation: This is a code-supported conditioning difference. It does not measure trained attention or prove a generation effect. Keep original architecture for the matched data comparison; preserve per-arm priors in content controls.
